entities.summary: Wang Su (195–256), courtesy name Ziyong, was an official and Confucian scholar of the state of Cao Wei during the Three Kingdoms period of China. He was a son of Wang Lang, and was born in Kuaiji. In c.212, when Wang Su was 18, he went to study the Taixuanjing under Song Zhong, and even wrote an annotation for the work.
